digest.component_or_area: LLM gate verdict signing and sidecar persistence
propositions: Signed gate verdicts currently record only a model string and do not capture which provider, endpoint, or tier produced them, making it impossible for consumers to distinguish Bedrock-backed from Anthropic-backed verdicts even though both are signed

A new additive `provider_provenance` object must be stamped into all three gate sidecars (plan-review, completion, code-review) carrying provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and effective capabilities, reusing the capabilities record resolved once per run rather than recomputing it

The `endpoint_host` field must extract only the hostname via `urlparse().hostname` to strip embedded credentials, and neither the credentials nor the api_key must appear anywhere in the persisted signed payload
Provenance assembly must live in capabilities.py as a leaf module taking only primitives (provider, model, base_url, caps) and not importing from runner or providers, to preserve the leaf invariant
The change must be backward-compatible: a legacy sidecar payload without provider_provenance must still load and verify, and the pre-existing model string field must remain byte-identical

The wiring from runner result through plan-review and completion gate verdict assembly to sidecar build_payload must be traced end-to-end, as constructed-input unit tests alone cannot prove the production path carries the record
